games.name: [UPD] Endless Battlegrounds
games.desc:
Endless Battlegrounds is inspired by many animes, including JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure (JJBA). Full credit goes to all the original creators.


PC Controls:
Left Click - Punch
1, 2, 3, 4 - Use Skills
Q - Dash (Hold during ragdoll to perform an evasive dash)
F - Block
G - Activate Awakening
B - Open Emote Wheel
Uppercut - Hold Jump + Left Click
Down Slam - Jump + Left Click


Note: This game is still in active development and receives frequent updates, you may encounter occasional bugs.
